name: Merge Safety Reviewer
description: Judges whether a GitHub PR is safe to merge. Reads only; posts nothing.
about: Point it at any repository you can reach with the GitHub CLI. It lists the open pull requests, takes the one you pick, and reads it end to end — diff, commits, CI and the code around the change — then gives a verdict and names the biggest risk. It never edits files and never posts to GitHub.
features: Judge whether a pull request is safe to merge
Trace blast radius through callers and tests
Catch regressions, races and migration risks
examplePrompt: Review the open pull requests in this repo and tell me whether the latest one is safe to merge.
